name: 71-namungumi
description: Namungumi: low wide dome-backed lake monster, slate-blue with bold pale grid lines, four short webbed limbs, red gums and pale tusks, one round eye in the middle of the dome.

action.breath: Slow heavy breath in place, facing the viewer: the dome swells and rises a little to its highest at the midpoint, then settles back. The eye stays in the same place. Same size, black one-pixel outlines, flat fills. No walking or effects.
action.walk: Shuffles sideways in place, facing the viewer: the four webbed limbs step in turn while the dome rocks slightly side to side and the eye stays level. Same size, black one-pixel outlines, flat fills. No effects.
